intent_summary: Provide explicit forward models, including UsageTap-compatible local trend, and compare bounded candidates on chronological full-horizon holdouts while preserving existing forecasts and anomaly evidence.

criteria.criterion: An explicit local-trend model reproduces UsageTap Current with outlier exclusion disabled, including its recent robust slope, centered seasonal offsets, future-only trend adjustment and positional bucket alignment.

Explicit naive, seasonal-naive, mean, median, smoothing, damped local trend and existing Anomalyzer models expose their settings and separate trend and seasonal components without modifying actual observations.

Selection evaluates every ranked candidate on the same earlier training prefixes and full requested-horizon holdouts, reports losses and failed candidates, and deterministically selects the smallest declared objective with stable ties.
criteria.notes: Shared holdouts, losses and failures are implemented, but the documented tie tolerance can select a strictly higher loss. For values [i*1e-14 for i in range(86)] with naive followed by local_trend, selection chooses naive with loss 7.5e-14 over local_trend with loss approximately 9.62e-30.

criteria.criterion: Partial tails never enter fitting or scoring, missing history is unavailable, and insufficient validation history or budget exhaustion never fabricates a selected or partially evaluated model.

Existing forecast and anomaly APIs retain their behavior; selection scores do not claim future optimality, calibrated anomaly evidence or uncertainty, and selected-model accuracy requires separate outer holdouts.
